chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Enters the Golden Sword Ceremony – Desolate Era Chapter 24
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning demands to leave the Western Prefecture to train. His father sets a condition: win the Golden Sword. Meanwhile, tribe youths register for the life-or-death tournament, and Ji Lie growls in the shadows.
og_title: The Golden Sword Vow – Desolate Era Chapter 24
og_description: Ji Ning, only ten, shocks his father with Unity of Man and Heaven footwork. He demands to roam the wilds and slay great demons—starting with the Golden Sword Ceremony.
twitter_title: Ji Ning's first big step: winning a Golden Sword at age ten!
twitter_description: The quadrennial Golden Sword Ceremony opens. Ji Ning vows to win and leave the nest to hunt great demons. His father's condition hides a deeper plot.
